inputs.style: Brutal Brazilian groove thrash, heavily downtuned guitars, syncopated palm-muted riffs, aggressive barked male English vocals, huge toms, tight dry heavy drums. 116 BPM, D minor. a percussive four-hit guitar motif; bass and tom responses; short commanding shouted refrain. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Iron links, cold steel breath
Chains that hold, now cut the death
Stone by stone, the wall exhales
Grey dust hangs in stagnant halls
We pull the weight, we drag the rust
Turn the shackles into dust

[Chorus]
Break the grey
Break the gaze
Concrete burns, the silence dies
Concrete Rebellion

[Verse]
Eyes of wire, watching deep
Now they blink in shattered sleep
Hands that bled, now hands that tear
Strip the city of its stare
The watchtower falls in two
Hollow light lets shadows through

[Chorus]
Break the grey
Break the gaze
Concrete burns, the silence dies
Concrete Rebellion

[Verse]
The last brick falls with a sickening thud
The eye in the sky cracks, then is mud
But the dust doesn’t settle down
It crawls into the lungs of the town
We breathe in the grey, we choke on the light
Every free breath turns to bitter night
The chains are gone, the wall is flat
But the city is choking on the trap
We tore the beast to make us free
Now we’re buried in the debris
The rebellion breathes, but cannot speak
The silence is the only weak

[Bridge]
One stone loose, the others groan
Weight of years, finally gone
The last link snaps, the floor gives way
We stand tall in the dust of day

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Break the grey
Break the gaze
Concrete burns, the silence dies
Concrete Rebellion

[Outro]
The wall is down
The city is found
Chains are gone
We are not strong
